examples.title: Example 1: Processing Styled Strings
examples.description: This example shows how to perform insertion, deletion, replacement, and viewing of styled strings using the insertString, removeStyles, replaceStyle, and getStyles APIs, available since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 2: Binding Events
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to bind events to styled strings using the styledKey and styledValue APIs of StyleOptions, available since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Text Style
examples.description: This example shows how to query and set styles for styled strings using the getStyles and setStyle APIs, available since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting Images
examples.description: This example illustrates how to set images in styled strings using the ImageAttachment API, available since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Text Line Height and Paragraph Style
examples.description: This example illustrates how to configure the line height and paragraph style of a styled string using the LineHeightStyle and ParagraphStyle APIs, available since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting Custom Spans
examples.description: This example illustrates how to configure custom spans for a styled string using CustomSpan and measureTextSize, supported since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 7: Storing Custom Extension Information
examples.description: This example illustrates how to store custom extension information within styled strings using the UserDataSpan API, available since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting a Hyperlink
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set a hyperlink within a styled string using the UrlStyle API, available since API version 14.

examples.title: Example 9: Setting a Color Filter for an Image
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to apply a color filter to an image by setting colorFilter for ImageAttachment, available since API version 15.

examples.title: Example 10: Inserting, Deleting, and Replacing Styled Strings
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to insert, delete, and replace styled strings using the subStyledString, removeString, removeStyle, clearStyles, replaceStyledString, and insertStyledString APIs, available since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 11: Configuring the Text Stroke for a Styled String
examples.description: This example illustrates how to configure the text stroke for a styled string by setting strokeWidth and strokeColor of TextStyle, available since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 12: Implementing Conversion Using fromHtml and toHtml
examples.description: This example illustrates how to convert HTML content to styled strings and back using the fromHtml (available since API version 12) and toHtml (available since API version 14) APIs. Supported HTML tags include strong, b20+, em20+, i20+, u20+, del20+, s20+, a20+, sub20+, and sup20+, along with their background-color style attributes.

examples.title: Example 13: Implementing Multiple Decoration Lines and Bold Decoration Lines
examples.description: This example illustrates how to display multiple decoration lines and bold decoration lines by configuring enableMultiType and thicknessScale in the DecorationStyle API, available since API version 20.

examples.title: Sample 14: Obtaining the Image Size in vp
examples.description: This example illustrates how to configure styled strings with images and obtain the image size in vp using the ImageAttachmentInterface API, available since API version 21.

examples.title: Example 15: Setting Custom Paragraph Indentation
examples.description: This example illustrates how to set paragraph indentation and customize indentation patterns using the LeadingMarginSpan API, available since API version 22.

examples.title: Example 16: Displaying an SVG Image Using the supportSvg2 Property
examples.description: Starting from API version 22, this example enables enhanced SVG usability capabilities through the SVG tag parsing enhancement feature by configuring the supportSvg2 property in ResourceImageAttachmentOptions.
